# Fashion Doniya BD

> Premium Bangladeshi unstitched yardage fabric storefront specializing in 2.5 Bahar (36–44 inch) and 3.5 Bahar (56–60 inch) fabrics, smart yardage calculation, custom tailoring measurements, and nationwide courier delivery.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/): Featured 2.5 & 3.5 Bahar fabric collections and editorial showcases
- [Shop](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/shop): Complete yardage fabric catalog with width, category, and price filters
- [3.5 Bahar Collection](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/fabric/3.5-bahar): Broad-width 56–60 inch fabrics
- [2.5 Bahar Collection](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/fabric/2.5-bahar): Standard-width 36–44 inch fabrics
- [Fabric Yard Calculator](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/calculator): Automatic yardage calculation by outfit type and addons
- [Custom Design Studio](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/custom-design): Custom measurements and AI fabric-to-outfit preview
- [Order Tracking](https://fashiondoniyabd.com/order-tracking): Real-time phone-verified order and courier tracking
